# Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge
We as members of this community pledge to make participation in our project a welcoming and inclusive experience for everyone, regardless of age, background, experience level, gender description, gender identity, gender expression, class, disability/disease, ethnicity, skin color, national origin, religion, relationship status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic of humans.

As members, we commit to fostering an environment we all feel safe in.

## Our Standards
Examples of behavior that contributes to a positive environment include:
- Using welcoming and inclusive language
- Being respectful of differing opinions, viewpoints, and experiences
- Gracefully accepting constructive criticism
- Focusing on what is best for the community
- Showing empathy towards other community members

Examples of unacceptable behavior include:
- The use of insensitive or offensive terminology in describing others
- Trolling, insulting/deriding abuise, jokes at the expense of others
- Personal attacks
- Public or private harassment
- Publishing others' private information, such as a physical or electronic address, without explicit permission
- Other forms of behavior that are detrimental to the welcome and safe environment

## Our Responsibilities
Community members who encounter unacceptable behavior should help resolve the situation in a respectful manner. Please report unacceptable behavior to the project team.

## Enforcement
Community project team members are responsible for clarifying and enforcing our standards of acceptable behavior and will take appropriate measures to actually actually enforce their community standards.
